contract_ref: A project cannot be operated unless startup context can be reconstructed deterministically from the registry

derivation_chain.step: 3 registry entries have incomplete startup metadata
scrum-tracker: startup_contract = null; runtime-node: startup_contract = null; working-bibliography-extension: missing required fields

finding.title: Contract reconstruction — three registry entries expose incomplete startup metadata
finding.description: Three projects in the workspace registry have incomplete startup metadata: scrum-tracker (startup_contract=null), runtime-node (startup_contract=null), working-bibliography-extension (missing required fields). The invariant says a project cannot be operated unless startup context can be reconstructed deterministically.
finding.invariant_violated: Every registered project must have complete startup metadata for deterministic reconstruction
finding.impact: These 3 projects cannot be started via the standard startup protocol; their startup context is non-reconstructible

affected_projects.issue: missing required fields in startup contract

recommendation.description: Either complete the startup metadata for these 3 projects or remove them from the registry if they are not intended to be startup-capable. The registry should not contain entries that cannot be operated.
recommendation.proposed_action: Owner decision required — are these projects intended to be startup-capable?
